nodes.description: Public provenance hash string state variable of BullsOnTheBlock.
Constant NFT price (0.08 ETH) used to validate msg.value in mintBull.
Constant maximum number of tokens allowed per purchase.
Maximum token supply (10000) used for mint and starting index modulo.
Boolean flag gating the mintBull function; toggled by flipSaleState.
Randomized starting index for token reveal, set by calcStartingIndex.
Block number used as entropy source for startingIndex computation.
Private base URI prefix used for token URI construction.
Mapping of tokenId to individual token URI string.
Owner-only function that toggles the saleIsActive flag.
Owner-only function that transfers the contract balance to msg.sender.
Owner-only function that mints 30 reserved tokens via _safeMint.
Payable public mint function accepting numberOfTokens and minting via _safeMint.
Owner-only function deriving startingIndex from blockhash and MAX_SUPPLY.
Owner-only function that sets startingIndexBlock to the current block number.
Owner-only function that sets the base URI for all tokens.
Public view function returning the token URI, combining base and token-specific URI.
Internal view override returning the extended base URI.
Internal ERC721 function that mints and calls _checkOnERC721Received on the recipient.
Internal ERC721 function transferring token ownership and balances.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, minting and withdrawal.
Low-gas ETH transfer of the full contract balance to msg.sender in withdraw.
External callback to recipient contract during _safeMint via _checkOnERC721Received, enabling reentrancy.
User-supplied parameter of mintBull controlling how many tokens are minted.
Owner-supplied parameter of setBaseURI assigned to _baseURIExtended.
Parameter of tokenURI identifying which token URI to resolve.
Local variable in withdraw holding address(this).balance.
Local variable in reserveTokens holding the current totalSupply.
Loop counter local variable in reserveTokens.

edges.reason: withdraw is guarded by onlyOwner which compares owner() against _msgSender(); msg.sender controls authorization and receives funds.
mintBull uses msg.sender as the mint recipient, so the caller directly influences token ownership.
flipSaleState is guarded by onlyOwner which relies on msg.sender identity.
reserveTokens is owner-only and mints reserved tokens to msg.sender.
calcStartingIndex is owner-only and depends on msg.sender passing the ownership check.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock is owner-only and depends on msg.sender identity.
setBaseURI is owner-only and gated by msg.sender via the onlyOwner modifier.
withdraw executes the unsafe payable transfer of the full balance to msg.sender.
mintBull invokes _safeMint in a loop, which performs the external onERC721Received callback before state finalization.
reserveTokens loops calling _safeMint, triggering the ERC721 receiver callback on contract recipients.
_safeMint calls _checkOnERC721Received which externally calls onERC721Received on the recipient, a reentrancy vector.
mintBull requires saleIsActive to be true before proceeding.
flipSaleState toggles the saleIsActive state variable.
mintBull reads MAX_SUPPLY to bound total supply.
mintBull reads NFT_PRICE to validate msg.value equals price times number of tokens.
mintBull reads MAX_NFT_PURCHASE to cap per-purchase quantity.
calcStartingIndex writes the computed startingIndex state variable.
calcStartingIndex reads startingIndexBlock to derive blockhash entropy.
calcStartingIndex takes modulo MAX_SUPPLY when computing startingIndex.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock writes startingIndexBlock to the current block number.
setBaseURI assigns the new base URI to _baseURIExtended.
tokenURI reads the per-token URI from the _tokenURIs mapping.
tokenURI calls _baseURI to obtain the base URI prefix.
_baseURI returns the _baseURIExtended state variable.
numberOfTokens drives the SafeMath add/mul arithmetic validating supply and payment.
baseURI_ parameter is stored into _baseURIExtended by setBaseURI.
tokenId_param selects the token whose URI is resolved in tokenURI.
balance local variable holds address(this).balance and is transferred in withdraw.
supply local captures totalSupply used as mint index in reserveTokens.
i loop counter advanced by unchecked-protected arithmetic in reserveTokens mint loop.

normalization_plan.reason: numberOfTokens is a parameter used exclusively inside mintBull for supply and payment validation.
baseURI_ is a parameter directly stored into _baseURIExtended by setBaseURI.
tokenId_param is a parameter consumed only by tokenURI when resolving the URI.
balance is a transient local in withdraw that is immediately transferred to msg.sender.
supply is a transient local in reserveTokens denoting the current total supply.
i is a transient loop counter in reserveTokens with no persistent semantic identity.
